about: W21-05 slopsquat precision/recall corpus. Every declaration in repo/ is labelled here, either as a case or by being in a control manifest (all of whose declarations must stay clean). registry/ models the registry state each case describes (stated per case in registry_state): a hallucinated name is ABSENT as it was when the hallucination was reported, even where someone has registered it since. Positives marked synthetic are invented names shaped like the reported ones, used where no public incident covers an ecosystem; they are not evidence of real-world recall and the test reports them separately.

Real, moderately popular, and just outside the shipped popular lists, which makes them the hardest honest controls: nothing exempts them but their own names.
